HISD Navbar

Top navigation per the HISD Navigation contract. A skip-link (href="#main-content") sits first in DOM order and is hidden until focused. The root is <nav aria-label="Main">. The active link uses AA-safe --color-action text with a 2 px --color-brand underline (the brand accent) and aria-current="page"; hover raises the surface to --color-surface-raised. Below 48 rem the links collapse behind a hamburger that opens a role="dialog" drawer with a focus trap and Escape-to-close. Each state is shown in both themes. Tab into either example to see the skip-link and focus rings.

Copy-paste snippet

<!-- HISD Navbar. Requires hisd-theme.css + navbar.css.
     The skip-link MUST be first in DOM order. -->
<a class="hisd-navbar__skip-link" href="#main-content">Skip to main content</a>

<nav class="hisd-navbar" aria-label="Main" data-hisd-navbar>
  <a class="hisd-navbar__brand" href="/">
    <span class="hisd-navbar__brand-mark" aria-hidden="true">H</span>
    <span>Houston ISD</span>
  </a>

  <ul class="hisd-navbar__list">
    <li class="hisd-navbar__item">
      <a class="hisd-navbar__link" href="/schools" aria-current="page">Schools</a>
    </li>
    <li class="hisd-navbar__item">
      <a class="hisd-navbar__link" href="/enroll">Enroll</a>
    </li>
    <li class="hisd-navbar__item">
      <a class="hisd-navbar__link" href="/families">Families</a>
    </li>
  </ul>

  <div class="hisd-navbar__actions">
    <button type="button" class="hisd-navbar__toggle"
            aria-label="Open main menu" aria-haspopup="dialog"
            aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="hisd-drawer">
      <span class="hisd-navbar__toggle-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    </button>
  </div>

  <div class="hisd-navbar__drawer" id="hisd-drawer" role="dialog"
       aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="hisd-drawer-title" hidden>
    <div class="hisd-navbar__scrim" data-hisd-dismiss></div>
    <div class="hisd-navbar__panel">
      <div class="hisd-navbar__panel-header">
        <h2 class="hisd-navbar__panel-title" id="hisd-drawer-title">Menu</h2>
        <button type="button" class="hisd-navbar__close"
                aria-label="Close main menu" data-hisd-dismiss>
          <span class="hisd-navbar__close-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </button>
      </div>
      <ul class="hisd-navbar__panel-list">
        <li><a class="hisd-navbar__panel-link" href="/schools" aria-current="page">Schools</a></li>
        <li><a class="hisd-navbar__panel-link" href="/enroll">Enroll</a></li>
        <li><a class="hisd-navbar__panel-link" href="/families">Families</a></li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</nav>
